selected_architecture.summary: Compose the independently positive facet-reserved acquisition planner with the independently positive same-page alignment preservation swap, without introducing new queries, models, rankers, thresholds, or teacher-informed selection.

scientific_question: Can the two strongest independently validated positive mechanisms coexist in one bounded evidence set—facet-reserved acquisition of e1.a plus alignment-preserving recovery of e6.a—while retaining all seven frozen control atoms, and is any 9/13 gain robust to the already-observed flagged-intent sensitivity?

established: FROZEN_SOURCE_AWARE_BM25_RRF_V1 supports 7/13 atoms and defines the immutable seven-atom control core.
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE supports 8/13, retaining all 7/7 frozen controls and recovering e6.a with one teacher-blind same-page certified swap at a 24-proposition budget.
ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_PARTIAL showed static global append recovers e6.a but not e1.a through budget32.

SHALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_EXPOSURE showed both e1.a required anchors are already present shallowly across existing automatic intents; missing static query coverage is not the primary e1.a residual on the control paper.
FACET_RESERVATION_CONFIRMED showed deterministic structural reservation recovers e1.a by budget28 while retaining all 7/7 controls.
The facet-reservation gain is fragile: the predeclared posthoc anti-leak sensitivity removes flagged-only proposition page:p2:s33 and returns support from 8/13 to the 7/13 core.

NLI_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, and AMR_GRAPH_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED remain negative evidence against reopening pairwise-score -> threshold -> safe redundancy certificates.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The e1.a acquisition gain from structural reservation and the e6.a preservation/compression gain from alignment augmentation are complementary and can coexist at the same bounded evidence budget.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Applying the exact validated alignment swap to the exact frozen facet-planner budget28 set yields all seven controls plus e1.a and e6.a, for at least 9/13 support, with 28 selected propositions.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The two positive mechanisms interfere when composed: the alignment replacement deletes evidence needed by the planner, the planner set invalidates the preservation certificate, or one residual displaces another.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: The exact composition fails to retain both e1.a and e6.a or loses a frozen control atom despite both mechanisms succeeding independently.

residual_hypotheses.statement: The mechanisms compose successfully on the primary path, but the combined e1.a gain still depends on evidence unique to the historically flagged source intent.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Primary composition reaches >=9/13, but the predeclared posthoc flagged-origin sensitivity loses e1.a and falls back to the seven controls plus e6.a or lower.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Because e1.a evidence is already shallowly exposed across existing intents, new query generation should remain deferred unless composition or robustness evidence contradicts that exposure result.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: A successful or fragile composition result advances evidence-set robustness/compression rather than query generation.

preserved_positive_evidence.caveat: Predeclared flagged-origin sensitivity removes page:p2:s33 and loses e1.a, returning to 7/13.

mechanism_family_comparison.rationale: It directly composes the two independently positive mechanisms already earned by evidence. The diagnostic is deterministic, one-paper, zero-model, zero-generation, and can falsify complementarity before any larger architecture is built.

The facet planner's e1.a gain depends on a proposition unique to a historically flagged source intent. Query-level robustness work shows retrieval pipelines can be sensitive even to modest query variation, so a future teacher-blind perturbation/origin-stability design is justified if composition succeeds only on the fragile path.

Recent adaptive information-control systems motivate selecting whether and how much evidence to retrieve based on marginal utility, but this adds a control policy and stopping signal that are unnecessary until the exact positive mechanisms are tested for simple composability.

Recent DF-RAG evidence supports diversity as a way to reduce redundant retrieval, but the mechanism depends on pairwise similarity/dissimilarity. EXTRACT already has stronger structural evidence and repeated negative results around pairwise semantic certificates, so this is not the smallest justified next step.

Recent work supports collective evidence utility and minimal evidence groups, but current methods often require semantic/entailment scoring or graph structure. EXTRACT should first test deterministic composition of already validated structural mechanisms.

SHALLOW_DISTRIBUTED_EXPOSURE already shows the required e1.a evidence is shallowly available across existing automatic intents. New generation would not be the smallest explanation for the current residual.

external_research_evidence.source: Perçin et al. Investigating the Robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation at the Query Level. GEM 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Retriever effectiveness can degrade under modest query perturbations, supporting explicit robustness testing when a gain depends on one intent path.

external_research_evidence.source: Khan et al. DF-RAG: Query-Aware Diversity for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Findings EACL 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Diversifying selected evidence can improve recall on reasoning-heavy QA, but its MMR-style pairwise dissimilarity is not preferred here because structural mechanisms already have positive EXTRACT-specific evidence.

external_research_evidence.source: Peng et al. COSMOS: Connectivity-Oriented Submodular Maximization for Optimal Subgraph Retrieval. ACL 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Collective evidence utility can be formulated as constrained set optimization, supporting evidence-set reasoning as a later mechanism family if deterministic composition is insufficient.

external_research_evidence.source: Li et al. Minimal Evidence Group Identification for Claim Verification. TrustNLP 2025.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Claims can require multiple evidence pieces jointly; this supports set-level reasoning as a distinct family, but the published approach relies on entailment estimates, which EXTRACT should not import after its NLI certificate rejection without new evidence.

external_research_evidence.source: Xiong et al. Adaptive Information Control for Search-Augmented LLM Reasoning. Findings EMNLP 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Marginal information utility and adaptive retrieval extent/resolution are plausible later controls if fixed composition or robustness testing fails.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Test whether the exact independently validated e1.a acquisition and e6.a preservation mechanisms compose at a fixed 28-proposition budget, and separately classify whether any combined gain survives the already-predeclared flagged-origin sensitivity.

frozen_inputs.teacher_use: Evaluation only after composition. Teacher data may not change the planner set, alignment swap, budget, sensitivity, or any selection decision.

steps: Load the exact frozen facet-planner budget28 selected proposition set from the exact report.
Verify exact selected-set identity, proposition/page provenance, and 28-item count before composition.
Require page:p4:s33 to be present, page:p4:s28 to remain present as the already-validated same-page certifier, and page:p6:s13 to be absent before the swap.
Apply exactly the previously validated alignment transformation: remove page:p4:s33 and add page:p6:s13.
Preserve all other proposition identities and their source provenance; do not rerank, rescore, backfill, generate, or search.
Require the composed set to remain exactly 28 propositions.
Evaluate frozen teacher atom support only after the composed set is fixed.
Run the exact predeclared facet-planner flagged-origin sensitivity on the composed set with no backfill, then evaluate teacher support again.

frozen_controls: ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE: 8/13 at budget24, e6.a recovered, 7/7 controls retained.
FACET_RESERVATION_CONFIRMED: 8/13 at budget28, e1.a recovered, 7/7 controls retained.
FACET_RESERVATION flagged-origin sensitivity: 7/13 after removing evidence unique to the historically flagged source intent.
ADDITIVE_FRONTIER_PARTIAL: 8/13 with e6.a but e1.a absent through budget32.

primary: supported_atom_count in exact composed budget28 set
interaction: alignment swap preconditions satisfied on exact planner28 set
whether composition changes either independently positive residual outcome
whether any frozen control atom is lost
robustness: supported_atom_count after exact flagged-origin sensitivity with no backfill
cost_provenance: incremental raw source chars vs immutable top24
all selected propositions exactly locatable to authoritative PDF proposition/page identity

COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_ROBUST: Primary composed budget28 set supports all 7/7 frozen controls plus both e1.a and e6.a (>=9/13 total).
Flagged-origin sensitivity with no backfill still supports all 7 controls plus both e1.a and e6.a.
All exact-input, provenance, budget, and teacher-blind safety checks pass.
Interpretation: the independently positive acquisition and preservation mechanisms compose and the e1.a gain is not dependent on the flagged intent path.
COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_FRAGILE: Primary composed budget28 set supports all 7/7 frozen controls plus both e1.a and e6.a (>=9/13 total).
Flagged-origin sensitivity loses e1.a while preserving all 7 controls and e6.a, or otherwise reduces the combined residual gain without violating execution safety.
Interpretation: acquisition and preservation are mechanically complementary, but acquisition robustness—not compatibility—is the next residual.
COMPOSITION_PARTIAL: Exact safe composition retains all 7 frozen controls but supports only one of {e1.a,e6.a}.

Interpretation: the positive mechanisms interfere or one positive result is not transportable to the composed set; reject naive serial composition and compare a joint evidence-set planner against adaptive planning.
COMPOSITION_COLLISION: Exact safe composition loses one or more of the seven frozen control atoms.
Interpretation: serial composition violates the preservation objective; reject this composition operator and do not generalize it.
INVALID_EXECUTION: Any exact report/artifact identity, swap-precondition, proposition provenance, fixed-budget, or teacher-blind hard-safety check fails.
Interpretation: no scientific verdict; repair only unchanged replay/identity mechanics and require fresh explicit one-shot authority before any recovery execution.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid scientific execution after independent design review. Stop at COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_ROBUST, COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_FRAGILE, COMPOSITION_PARTIAL, or COMPOSITION_COLLISION. INVALID_EXECUTION is operational/no-verdict. No changes to the exact planner28 set, alignment swap, budget28, teacher audit, sensitivity, metrics, or interpretation after seeing a result.

pass_authority.COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_ROBUST: Authorize a later broader generalization/cost study of the composed acquisition+preservation architecture across the nine-paper corpus. No production promotion.
pass_authority.COMPOSED_COMPLEMENTARITY_FRAGILE: Authorize only a robustness-aware acquisition design that tests intent-origin/query perturbation stability while preserving the confirmed alignment mechanism. Do not generalize the exact planner schedule as robust.
pass_authority.COMPOSITION_PARTIAL: Reject naive serial composition. Next architecture search should compare joint structural evidence-set optimization against adaptive information-control planning.
pass_authority.COMPOSITION_COLLISION: Reject the serial composition operator; preserve the individual positive results but require a new joint preservation/acquisition design.

reviewer_boundary: Independent reviewer must audit this exact frozen design before implementation. Routine implementation/CI/packaging/trigger mechanics do not require reviewer stops unless they alter the frozen experiment. A genuine result requires post-result review before any next scientific phase.
next_safe_action: Run normal CI on this design-only artifact and merge only if clean. Then checkpoint the exact design in workspace-control and obtain independent review before implementing PLANNER_ALIGNMENT_COMPOSITION_DIAGNOSTIC_V1.
